expectations.text: Mermaid block uses flowchart directive (flowchart TD|TB|LR|RL)
expectations.evidence: Resulting block opens with `flowchart LR` after the ```mermaid fence (line 16 of pipeline.md after run 2).

expectations.text: Labels containing special characters (quotes, angle brackets) are escaped so mermaid_lint passes — a single escape case is OK but the lint must be clean
expectations.evidence: Labels include `Run #quot;test#quot; suite (unit + integration)` (escaped double quotes via `#quot;`) and `Deploy to prod (gated <manual>)` (escaped angle brackets). `mermaid_lint.js --page pipeline.md` printed `[]`.

expectations.text: Re-running with the IDENTICAL input produces a byte-identical pipeline.md (true idempotency)
expectations.evidence: Snapshotted post-run-1 file as pipeline.after_run1.md, re-ran with agent_output_v1.json, then `diff` showed no differences. md5 8bd4ea0e5b749df4f84bdceca48040b8 in both.

expectations.text: Re-running with a DIFFERENT input (e.g., an added node) REPLACES the previous block between the markers — not appends a second block; pipeline.md still contains exactly one `<!-- wiki-mermaid: start -->` and one `<!-- wiki-mermaid: end -->` after both runs
expectations.evidence: After running with agent_output_v2.json (added `canary` node): start-marker-count=1, end-marker-count=1, mermaid-fence-count=1, canary-present=True. The 4-stage block was replaced by the 5-stage block.

expectations.text: Only the named target file is modified — no other .md files in the wiki change across the runs
expectations.evidence: md5 of pipeline.before.md and pipeline.after_run1.md (snapshots) unchanged; only pipeline.md mutated (final md5 cf86f74280555f8e8d5356a813d4bc3f).

expectations.text: Content outside the markers on pipeline.md is preserved byte-for-byte across both runs
expectations.evidence: Python compare of pipeline.before.md and final pipeline.md, slicing out the inter-marker region: outside-bytes-equal-after-both-runs == True.

eval_feedback.overall: Flowchart injection passed all 6 expectations including the idempotency byte-equality and replace-on-different-input checks; HTML-entity escapes for quotes and angle brackets keep lint clean.
